question: Mention the category of events which were held at MU 215.
evidence: held at MU 215 refers to location = 'MU 215'
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching budget record.
gold: SELECT T2.category FROM event AS T1 LEFT JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.location = 'MU 215'
gold0: SELECT T2.category FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.location = 'MU 215'

b.request: Which categories of events held at location 'MU 215' exist, including events that have no matching budget record (i.e., a left join from event to budget so the category is NULL when no budget exists)?
b.sql: SELECT DISTINCT b.category FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'

d.request: Which category of events were held at MU 215, including rows that have no matching budget record?
d.sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.type FROM event e LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
